items.desc_tr: Ezine peyniri, Kars gravyeri, petek bal-kaymak, sucuklu menemen, sıcacık pişi ve sınırsız demlik çay.
items.desc_en: Aged artisanal cheeses, honeycomb clotted cream, skillet spicy menemen, warm Turkish donuts & free-flowing black tea.

items.desc_tr: Sekapark fırınından ekşi mayalı ekmek, ezilmiş avokado, organik poşe yumurta ve trüf yağı damlaları.
items.desc_en: Artisanal toasted sourdough, crushed Haas avocado, organic poached eggs, microgreens, truffle drops.

items.desc_tr: Köy yumurtası, sulu Çanakkale domatesi, tatlı köy biberi ve bol tereyağ.
items.desc_en: Farm-fresh eggs softly scrambled with vine tomatoes, sweet green peppers and clarified butter.

items.desc_tr: Etiyopya Yirgacheffe espresso, ev yapımı tuzlu karamel şurubu, mikrokremalı yulaf sütü ve 24k yenilebilir altın tozu dokunuşu.
items.desc_en: Single origin Ethiopian espresso, handcrafted sea-salt caramel, micro-textured oat milk & edible gold dust.

items.desc_tr: 20 saat soğuk damlatma ile demlenen Guatemala çekirdekleri, narenciye tonları ve biberiye tütsüsü.
items.desc_en: 20-hour Kyoto slow-drip Guatemala coffee with citrus notes, dried orange slice and smoked rosemary.

items.desc_tr: Bakır cezvede közde yavaş pişirilen taze çekilmiş Türk kahvesi, güllü Hacı Bekir lokumu ve damla sakızlı su.
items.desc_en: Slow-brewed over hot sand in vintage copper ibrik, served with authentic rose Turkish delight and mastic water.

items.desc_tr: Gevrek çıtır Belçika waffle hamuru, eritilmiş Callebaut çikolata, taze çilek, muz, böğürtlen ve Antep fıstığı krokan.
items.desc_en: Crisp liege waffle, molten Belgian dark & milk chocolate, wild berries, banana slices and roasted Antep pistachio dust.

items.name_tr: San Sebastian Cheesecake & Sıcak Çikolata Sosu
items.desc_tr: İpeksi akışkan iç dolgu, karamelize yanık kabuk ve yanında masada dökülen sıcak Belçika çikolatası.
items.desc_en: Silky creamy center, caramelized exterior, drenched with molten warm chocolate tableside.

items.desc_tr: Dev fırınlanmış patates, tuzlu köy tereyağı, kaşar peyniri, sosis, mısır, Rus salatası ve özel mezelerle harmanlanmış.
items.desc_en: Giant oven-baked potato whipped with pure butter, aged kashar, spiced sausages, sweetcorn and gourmet toppings.

items.desc_tr: Kars gravyeri, tütsülenmiş Çerkes peyniri, gouda, ceviz, kuru incir, taze üzüm ve zeytin ezmeli krakerler.
items.desc_en: Selection of aged local and imported cheeses, smoked cuts, walnuts, dried figs, grapes and artisanal crackers.

items.desc_tr: Taze el kesimi çıtır patates, beyaz trüf yağı, rendelenmiş 24 aylık parmesan ve ev yapımı trüflü mayonez.
items.desc_en: Hand-cut golden fries tossed with white truffle oil, 24-month aged parmesan and house garlic aioli.

items.desc_tr: Marine edilmiş ızgara tavuk göğsü, dana bacon, çedar peyniri, taze marul, domates ve trüflü patates eşliğinde.
items.desc_en: Tender marinated chicken breast, beef bacon, melted cheddar, crisp lettuce, heirloom tomato on artisan brioche.

customer_reviews.name: Caner Öztürk
customer_reviews.comment_tr: Sekapark'ın açık ara en elit ve huzurlu mekânı. Gün batımında terasta oturup denize karşı kahve yudumlamak inanılmaz bir deneyim. Canlı müzik kalitesi ve personelin nezaketi kusursuz.
customer_reviews.comment_en: By far the most elite and tranquil venue in Sekapark. Watching the sunset with artisanal coffee right on the water is magical. Flawless live music and attentive staff.

customer_reviews.name: Selin & Mert Kaya
customer_reviews.comment_tr: Hafta sonu serpme kahvaltısı için İzmit'e geldik. Peynir çeşitleri, sıcacık pişisi ve Körfez manzarası olağanüstüydü. 24 saat açık olması da gece geç saatlerde kahve içmek için harika bir avantaj.
customer_reviews.comment_en: Traveled here for the gourmet Turkish breakfast. Cheeses, fresh donuts and the sweeping Gulf view were spectacular. Open 24/7 is a huge plus for late night coffee.

customer_reviews.name: David Harrison
customer_reviews.comment_tr: Business trip to Kocaeli ended with a stunning dinner here. The waffles, espresso quality and the twilight sea lights are world-class. Highly recommended!
customer_reviews.comment_en: Ended my business trip to Kocaeli with a stunning evening here. The Belgian waffle, single origin espresso and twilight sea lights are world-class.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Strictly follow dark luxury theme (#070D18 base, #0F172A surfaces, #D4AF37 gold accents).
Never use raw transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or the sticky nav bar. Use solid dark with heavy backdrop blur (rgba(7, 13, 24, 0.88) + backdrop-blur-xl).
Ensure both Turkish (TR) and English (EN) languages are fully selectable and instantly switch all texts, labels, badges, and menus without page reload.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='reserve-table-hero-btn', data-testid='menu-tab-breakfast', data-testid='language-toggle-btn').
Keep phone number '0530 642 11 85' as real interactive 'tel:' and 'https://wa.me/905306421185' links for effortless mobile conversion.
Include working reservation form that validates inputs and presents an elegant confirmation toast/modal with booking ID.
